texts: When mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers store the mire-essence in clay vessels.
If mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers keep the mire-essence in clay vessels.
The Keepers draw stored mire-essence when they tend lanterns.
Stored mire-essence feeds future lantern lighting.

q1_issues.issue: Fusing the participial modifier into `stored_mire_essence` contradicts the compound rule — a participle used as a modifier is an incidental-description adjective (`a laminated worktop` -> `(Member sk_worktop_1 laminated)`, `a dented pail` -> two atoms), not a classifier that names a recognized kind.
The genus jumps from `stored_mire_essence` straight to `essence`, so no atom links the symbol to the `mire_essence` compound and nothing stated about mire-essence can reach it.

`(Inheritance future_lighting future)` exposes a temporal modifier that is none of the three licensed modifier-genus categories (gradable, positional/cardinal, material adjective) and fails the predicability test the instruction set gives ("the lighting is future").

q2_gaps: a restrictive modifier on a bare-kind argument of a kind-level relational generic — the `(Carry mosquito malaria)` form takes bare unmodified kinds, and the instruction set offers no way to restrict such an argument other than minting a fused compound symbol
a compound whose head is itself a compound (`stored` + `mire-essence`) — "decompose once, to single-word lemmas, then stop" gives no route that preserves the intermediate compound link
review_run1.notes: Routing to a kind-level relation is right (both arguments are bare mass NPs) and `Feed` is licensed as an open-class kind relation at the prescribed 0.9/0.9; the defects are all in the compound symbols and their decompositions.

fields.sentence: When mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers store the mire-essence in clay vessels.
parse_run2: (: mire_form_store (Implication (And (Member $x form) (Patient $x mire_essence) (Location $x sk_cauldron_1)) (And (Member (sk_store $x) store) (Agent (sk_store $x) keepers) (Theme (sk_store $x) mire_essence) (Location (sk_store $x) clay_vessel) (During (sk_store $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: Capitalized "Keepers" is encoded as an anonymous definite-plural group witness with no `Name` atom, so the proper-noun record that Names and casing makes mandatory (name symbol + exactly one Name fact) is lost.

q2_gaps: bare habitual "When <clause>, <clause>" as a standing generic conditional: the instruction set routes only "every time / whenever" to an occurrence rule, and otherwise lists "when" among the temporal connectives that keep the time-section forms, so which of the two applies here is undecided

a definite-plural group subject with a distributive predicate ("the Keepers store …") sitting inside a rule consequent: Cardinality/Quantifiers require the group event plus a per-member distribution rule, but nothing says whether that per-member rule is also emitted under an Implication
review_run1.notes: The rule otherwise follows the whenever pattern exactly (trigger clause as premises, Skolem-function response event, During link, STV 1.0 0.9), and correctly puts Location on the storing event only. Bare-kind fillers (mire_essence, clay_vessel) are the generic/non-specific-object use the Existential section licenses.

fields.sentence: If mire-essence forms in the cauldron, the Keepers keep the mire-essence in clay vessels.
parse_run2: (: i1_form_keep_rule (Implication (And (Member $x form) (Patient $x $m) (Member $m mire_essence) (Location $x sk_cauldron_1)) (And (Member (sk_keep $x) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $x) keepers) (Theme (sk_keep $x) $m) (Location (sk_keep $x) clay_vessel) (During (sk_keep $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's `(During (sk_keep $x) $x)` asserts that the keeping is temporally contained in the forming event, which the conditional never states — the storing follows the forming rather than occurring inside it.

q2_gaps: a capitalized common noun under a definite article naming an in-world order or body ("the Keepers") — the casing cue makes a capitalized run a proper noun needing a `Name` atom, but nothing says how to treat a capitalized definite PLURAL role title, so it lands as a plain group witness with no `Name`

whether an ordinary indicative "if P, Q" inherits the whenever-rule's `During` link, or only the plain `Implication` — the counterfactual section routes it to "a plain Implication rule" without saying which parts of the occurrence-quantifying machinery come along
review_run1.notes: The rule leaves the formed essence as the bare kind constant `mire_essence` in both premise and consequent rather than binding it to a variable, so the thing kept is only kind-identical to the thing that formed; that is defensible under the bare-class-symbol licence for non-specific objects but flattens the anaphora. Compound decomposition (`mire_essence`, `clay_vessel`), definite projection of "the cauldron", and the unmarked habitual consequent are all correct.

fields.sentence: The Keepers draw stored mire-essence when they tend lanterns.
parse_run2: (: keepers_draw_rule (Implication (And (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1) (Member $t tend) (Agent $t $x) (Theme $t lantern)) (And (Member (sk_draw $t) draw) (Agent (sk_draw $t) $x) (Theme (sk_draw $t) (sk_essence $t)) (Member (sk_essence $t) mire_essence) (Member (sk_essence $t) stored) (During (sk_draw $t) $t))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The trigger clause sits in the rule PREMISE as a Skolem-function term `(sk_tend $x)`, which no asserted tending event can ever match, so the rule can never fire on an actual occurrence — the whenever pattern puts an ordinary event variable in the premise and uses a Skolem function only in the consequent.

The drawn "stored mire-essence" is a single top-level constant witness asserted outside the conditional, so the parse asserts as a standing fact that a specific quantity of stored mire-essence exists, and shares one portion across every Keeper and every occasion where the dependent-existential (Skolem-function) form is called for.

q2_gaps: habitual "when <clause>" whose main clause has a definite-plural (group) subject: the whenever construction ranges over occurrences while the group-distribution rule ranges over members, and the instruction set never says how to combine the two ranges in one Implication (or that a bare "when", as opposed to "every time / whenever", triggers the rule form at all — "when" is otherwise listed as a temporal connective keeping the canonical Time-section forms)
a capitalized definite plural naming an in-world order ("the Keepers"): proper noun (name-derived constant + Name atom) versus ordinary definite-plural group witness is not adjudicated
review_run1.notes: No Name atom is emitted for the capitalized "Keepers". The mire_essence genus, the participle-as-adjective `stored`, and the Patient/Theme role choices all follow the instruction set.

fields.sentence: Stored mire-essence feeds future lantern lighting.

q1_issues.issue: The restrictive modifier of "stored mire-essence" is re-emitted as a generic property atom (Inheritance mire_essence stored, 0.9 0.9), asserting that mire-essence at large is stored, whereas the sentence only uses "stored" to restrict which essence does the feeding.

Likewise (Inheritance lantern_lighting future) asserts that lantern lighting in general holds a property `future`, though "future" only restricts which lighting is fed, and futurity has no property encoding at all in the instruction set.

q2_gaps: restrictive adjectival/participial modifier on a bare kind argument of a kind-level relational generic — the adjective+noun rule bars fusing an incidental-description modifier, ConditionalProperty takes a property (not a relation), and there is no other licensed carrier for the restriction

temporal modification of a nominal ("future lantern lighting") — Future is a status operator over an event or a copular atom, never over a kind term, so a future-restricted kind argument has no licensed form
review_run1.notes: The relational-generic routing is right: both arguments are bare kind-denoting NPs, so (Feed mire_essence lantern_lighting) at 0.9 0.9 plus the two compound genera (noun modifiers correctly left unexposed) are exactly as specified. The whole defect is that the two restricting modifiers get promoted into unrestricted kind-level assertions.
